article.headline: Super El Niño triggers storm surge across Southern United States this winter
article.summary: NOAA forecasts an active, storm-heavy winter pattern across the Southern U.S. driven by an 83% chance of a record-breaking Super El Niño.
article.body: Central equatorial Pacific water temperatures surpassed 2 degrees Celsius above normal during September, pushing current conditions into the high-stakes territory known as a Super El Niño. NOAA reports there is now an 83% likelihood that this season will become the strongest event of its kind since official record-keeping began in 1950, a notable jump from the 75% probability estimated just one month prior. This atmospheric shift essentially acts as a conveyor belt, extending the Pacific jet stream and directing a higher frequency of storms across the Southern Tier of the country. Residents from Southern California through the Southern Plains and into Florida should prepare for a particularly wet season as this climate phase takes hold. While the increased precipitation is expected to provide much-needed relief for drought-afflicted regions, NOAA officials have issued warnings that the influx of moisture onto dry, parched soil creates an elevated risk for destructive flash floods and sudden mudslides. Beyond the storm-prone South, the broader seasonal forecast points toward warmer-than-average temperatures settling over the majority of the remaining United States. Meteorological winter officially commences on December 1 and spans through the end of February, marking the period during which these El Niño-driven patterns are expected to exert their greatest influence. The event is defined by the El Niño-Southern Oscillation cycle, where significantly warmer water in the equatorial Pacific fundamentally alters global atmospheric circulation and shifts traditional storm tracks. Forecasters will continue to monitor whether sea surface temperatures remain at least 2 degrees above average for a three-month duration, the final threshold required to formally classify the season as a sustained Super El Niño event.

article.headline: Ballina woman scoops $100 million Powerball jackpot with single winning ticket
article.summary: A woman from Ballina, NSW, became Australia's third-biggest lottery winner after matching all seven numbers and the Powerball on Thursday night, crediting the win to a sign from a recently deceased family member.
article.body:
The Ballina resident's initial reaction to the news was disbelief. "Bloody hell! Is this my cousin pranking me?" she said after receiving a call from Powerball operator The Lott confirming her division one win. She was the only person in Australia to correctly match all seven numbers plus the Powerball number on Thursday night.

The winner's $100 million jackpot places her among Australia's largest lottery winners in history, ranking as the country's third-biggest prize. She purchased her entry online, adding to the randomness of her windfall.

The woman attributed her extraordinary fortune to spiritual intervention. "We recently had a death in the family, and I think it's a sign from them; they're so looking after me!" she explained. She reported experiencing signs throughout the day, describing objects moving and items waving in the wind as confirmations of the family member's involvement in her luck.

Her immediate plans center on practical and generous use of the funds. She intends to pay off her mortgage and assist family members in need. "This will help a lot of people. Not just me but lots of family members," she said. Her celebration will be modest by comparison: "Celebrating with breakfast in bed tomorrow - scrambled eggs and bacon for me!"

news.og_title: عام / خادم الحرمين الشريفين يصدر أمرًا ملكيًا بترقية وتعيين 26 قاضيًا بديوان المظالم
news.og_desc:
الرياض 05 جمادى الأولى 1448 هـ الموافق 16 أكتوبر 2026 م واس
    أصدر خادم الحرمين الشريفين الملك سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود -حفظه الله- أمرًا ملكيًا بترقية وتعيين (26) قاضيًا بديوان المظالم.
    وأوضح معالي رئيس ديوان المظالم رئيس مجلس القضاء الإداري الدكتور علي بن أحمد الأحيدب، أن الأمر الملكي الكريم تضمن ترقية وتعيين أربعة عشر قاضيًا على درجة (قاضي/ب)، وترقية اثني عشر قاضيًا إلى درجة (قاضي/ج).
    وأكد أن الأمر الملكي يأتي ليعزز الكوادر القضائية، ويرفع كفاءة العمل القضائي وجودة مخرجاته، مفيدًا أن القضاء الإداري يحظى برعاية ودعم خادم الحرمين الشريفين واهتمام ومتابعة سمو ولي العهد -حفظهما الله- وهو ما يؤكده هذا الأمر الملكي بدعم ديوان المظالم، وتحفيز قضاته وكوادره في جميع المجالات، ومواصلة مسيرة القضاء الإداري الرائدة.
    // انتهى //
